questions.Description:
Design of a Single bedroom multi-story apartment (G+ 4) that fits within a Conner plot sized 4800 sq ft land area with adjacent 30m wide road, considering privacy, space optimization, sustainability, and functionality. The solution should combine modern architecture with practical considerations for a diverse range of residents, offering comfort, flexibility, and environmental responsibility.
----media/image1.png----
1) Site Requirements :-
i) Parking for car and two wheeler
ii) Landscape
iii) Transformer location
2) Individual Unit Requirements :-
i) Living room
ii) Dining room
iii) Master bedroom attach toilet
iv) Common toilet
v) Kitchen
